name: Globular Cluster
author: Buziris
description: Do a double click shortly after clicking the second spider orb at 24% to fall above the gameplay between the structures. Move back down into the gameplay above the cube portal at 26%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the swing until 28% where you can go under the gameplay after your icon touches the gravity portal. Stay slightly under the gameplay until 31% where you can fall up to make it above the gameplay at 33%. Land on the platform above the cube portal at 35% and then don’t click. At 57%, start maintaining a constant position of being slightly above the gameplay and stay at that position until 76% where you can fall down onto the platform. Click once at 81% to go above the gameplay after the transition and then don’t click again. Free to the end from there.
